title: Senior .NET Backend Engineer
description: Quillfern Analytics builds reporting tools that help mid-sized retailers understand their sales data. You will join a backend team of six engineers who own the ingestion and query APIs. Our stack is C# on .NET, ASP.NET Core, PostgreSQL and Docker, deployed to Azure. You will design new endpoints, tune slow queries and review pull requests with a focus on maintainability. We are looking for solid experience with relational databases and clean, well-tested service code.

title: Angular Frontend Developer
description: Haldrove Logistics runs a freight-planning platform used by dispatchers across Europe. As an Angular developer you will build the screens dispatchers use all day: route boards, load tables and live shipment maps. We work in Angular with TypeScript and RxJS, and we care about accessible, keyboard-friendly interfaces. You will pair with designers and backend engineers to ship features end to end. Two office days a week in our Hamburg hub are expected.

title: Senior React Engineer
description: Nimbalo Payments offers checkout and invoicing tools for small online shops. You will lead frontend work on the merchant dashboard, built with React, TypeScript and Next.js on top of a GraphQL API. Expect to shape component architecture, mentor other engineers and keep performance budgets in check. We value thorough testing with Jest and a pragmatic approach to design systems. The team is fully remote within European time zones.

title: Data Engineer (Python)
description: Vantorra Health builds analytics for clinics that want to shorten patient waiting times. You will maintain and extend the pipelines that turn anonymised scheduling data into daily reports. The work is mostly Python and SQL, orchestrated with Apache Airflow and processed with Spark on AWS. You will improve data quality checks and help analysts self-serve. Experience with batch pipelines and a careful attitude to sensitive data are essential.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Kelvara Energy monitors solar farms and forecasts their output for grid operators. You will own our build pipelines and the Kubernetes clusters that run the forecasting services. Day to day you will write Terraform, harden Docker images and improve observability on AWS. You will work on site in our Valencia office alongside the platform and data teams. Comfort with Linux administration and incident response is expected.

title: Junior QA Automation Engineer
description: Mossquill Learning makes an online classroom platform for language schools. You will join the QA guild and write end-to-end tests with Playwright and TypeScript for the teacher and student apps. A senior engineer will mentor you through test design, flaky-test triage and release checks. Basic SQL for preparing test data and confident Git usage are required. This is a good first role for someone who enjoys finding edge cases.

title: Lead Full-Stack Engineer
description: Orvexa Robotics builds warehouse picking robots and the fleet software that coordinates them. You will lead a team of five engineers working on the operator console, a React and TypeScript app backed by .NET services on AWS. You will set technical direction, run design reviews and still write code most weeks. Close collaboration with hardware and field-support teams is part of the job. We are looking for someone who has led a product team through several releases.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Tessaline Games publishes cooperative puzzle games for mobile and console. You will build models that personalise level difficulty and detect players who are about to churn. The work spans feature pipelines in SQL, training in Python with PyTorch, and serving models in Docker on AWS. You will partner with game designers to turn experiments into shipped features. Experience taking models from notebook to production is a must.

title: Mobile Developer (Flutter)
description: Larkspan Travel helps small tour operators sell day trips through a white-label mobile app. We are looking for a contractor to rebuild the booking flow in Flutter and add offline ticket storage. You will work with our REST API and Firebase for push notifications and analytics. The engagement is expected to last around six months with a possible extension. Rates are agreed individually depending on experience.

title: Frontend Intern
description: Cobaltreed Studio is a small product studio building web apps for cultural institutions. As an intern you will help build exhibition guides and ticketing pages in Angular and TypeScript. You will get a dedicated mentor, weekly code reviews and a clear learning plan. Solid HTML and CSS fundamentals and some JavaScript experience are enough to start. The internship is paid and based in our Krakow studio.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Ashvelt Cloudworks provides managed message queues for development teams that do not want to run their own brokers. As an SRE you will keep a multi-region Kubernetes platform healthy and help define service level objectives. You will write tooling in Go, improve alerting in Prometheus and take part in a fair on-call rotation. We expect deep familiarity with AWS networking and container runtimes. Blameless post-mortems and written design docs are part of our culture.

title: Backend Developer (Python/Django)
description: Velloria Retail runs an online marketplace for independent fashion boutiques. You will work on the order and inventory services written in Python with Django, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis. Typical tasks include building new APIs for the mobile app, improving background jobs and writing database migrations safely. You will join a friendly team that ships to production several times a day. Experience with Docker-based local development is a plus.

title: BI Analyst
description: Gravelune Insurance is modernising how its claims department tracks performance. This part-time role builds Power BI dashboards on top of a SQL data warehouse and answers ad-hoc questions from team leads. You will clean up existing Excel reports and automate the repetitive ones with Python. The schedule is flexible, with one office day per week in Vienna. Clear communication with non-technical colleagues matters as much as query skills.

title: Frontend Architect (Angular)
description: Quillfern Analytics is consolidating several frontend apps into one Angular monorepo managed with Nx. As frontend architect you will define module boundaries, state management patterns with NgRx and shared UI libraries. You will coach three feature teams, review critical changes and keep build times under control. Strong TypeScript and RxJS skills and experience with large Angular codebases are required. The role is hybrid from our Warsaw office.

title: Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description: Nimbalo Payments processes invoices and refunds for thousands of small merchants. You will build event-driven services in Node.js and TypeScript that consume and publish Kafka events. Data lives in PostgreSQL and everything runs in Docker on AWS. You will help make payment flows idempotent and easy to audit. Our Utrecht office hosts the team two days a week.

title: Cloud Engineer (Azure)
description: Brindlemoor Bank is moving its retail banking services from on-premise servers to Azure. You will design landing zones with Terraform, automate operational tasks with PowerShell and support .NET teams during migration. Security reviews and change management are part of the process, so patience with documentation helps. The role is based in our Brussels office. Prior experience in a regulated industry is a strong advantage.

title: Freelance React Native Developer
description: Larkspan Travel needs a freelance React Native developer to maintain the guide companion app used by tour leaders. Work includes fixing crash reports, upgrading dependencies and adding small features requested by operators. The codebase is TypeScript with a REST backend owned by our core team. Expect roughly two days of work per week, scheduled flexibly. Please describe similar maintenance engagements when you apply.

title: Application Security Engineer
description: Corvanta Security runs penetration tests and secure-development programmes for software vendors. You will review customer architectures, run threat-modelling workshops and build internal scanners in Python. Many engagements involve containerised workloads on Kubernetes and AWS, so hands-on cloud experience is important. You should know the OWASP top risks well and be able to explain fixes to developers. The team works on site in Zurich.

title: Middle .NET Developer
description: Fennick Agritech builds software that helps farms plan irrigation and track crop health from satellite data. You will develop backend services in C# and .NET with Entity Framework Core and SQL Server, hosted on Azure. The team is small, so you will touch everything from API design to background processing. We expect a few years of commercial .NET experience and solid SQL. The role is hybrid from our Lviv office.

title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
description: Ovantia Logistics operates parcel lockers and needs better internal tools for its operations team. As a junior full-stack developer you will build admin pages in React and small Node.js services that talk to a SQL database. You will learn from experienced engineers through pairing and regular feedback. A portfolio project or internship experience with JavaScript or TypeScript is enough to apply. The team works from our Kyiv office.

title: Data Scientist
description: Vantorra Health is expanding its clinic analytics into Germany and is hiring a data scientist in Berlin. You will build forecasting models for appointment demand and help clinics act on the results. Most work happens in Python with pandas and scikit-learn, with data pulled via SQL from our AWS warehouse. You will present findings to clinic managers and product leads. A strong statistics background and clear writing are essential.

title: QA Engineer
description: Mossquill Learning needs a contract QA engineer for the launch of a new assessment module. You will extend an existing Selenium suite written in C#, test APIs with Postman and verify data with SQL. Close collaboration with developers and product owners in a remote Scrum team is expected. The contract runs for one release cycle with the option to continue. Compensation is discussed during the first call.

title: Game Backend Engineer
description: Tessaline Games is building online co-op features for its next title. You will develop matchmaking, leaderboards and player inventory services in C# on .NET, using Redis for fast state. Services run in Docker on AWS and must handle traffic spikes on launch days. You will work in our Montreal studio next to gameplay programmers and designers. Experience with low-latency services or multiplayer games is a plus.

title: UI Engineer
description: Cobaltreed Studio is growing its component library and needs a part-time UI engineer. You will turn Figma designs into accessible React components, document them in Storybook and keep styles consistent. The role suits someone who enjoys the space between design and engineering. Working hours are flexible and fully remote. Strong CSS skills and an eye for detail matter most.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description: Halvering Media runs a network of podcast and video channels and measures audiences across many platforms. You will build the shared data platform that ingests listening and viewing events. The stack is Python, SQL and Spark on AWS, with infrastructure managed in Terraform and Docker. You will define standards that other data teams build on. The role is remote and contracted through our London entity.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description: Orvexa Robotics is hiring an embedded engineer to work on the motion controllers inside its picking robots. You will write C++ and Rust for real-time Linux targets and build Python tooling for hardware-in-the-loop tests. Debugging on real robots in our Pittsburgh lab is a regular part of the week. Experience with real-time systems and hardware interfaces is required. You will collaborate closely with mechanical and electrical engineers.

title: Backend Engineer (Go)
description: Ashvelt Cloudworks is building a control plane for its managed queue product. You will write Go services exposing gRPC APIs, store state in PostgreSQL and deploy to Kubernetes. The team values small, well-reviewed changes and clear interfaces between services. You will also help improve local development with Docker. Prior Go experience is preferred, but strong backend engineers learning Go are welcome.

title: Engineering Manager
description: Haldrove Logistics is looking for an engineering manager for its dispatch product area. You will lead two teams building .NET services and Angular frontends on AWS. Your focus will be hiring, growing engineers, and keeping delivery predictable without burning people out. You will partner with product management on roadmap trade-offs. A background as a hands-on engineer and experience managing managers or tech leads are expected.

title: Java Backend Developer
description: Brindlemoor Bank is rebuilding its account-opening journey as a set of Spring Boot services. You will implement business rules in Java, integrate with Kafka event streams and write careful SQL against the core banking database. Code reviews, automated tests and audit-friendly logging are non-negotiable here. The team works in Antwerp three days a week. Experience in financial services is helpful but not required.

title: DevOps Contractor
description: Halvering Media needs an experienced DevOps contractor to consolidate several AWS accounts and standardise deployments. You will migrate pipelines to GitHub Actions, codify infrastructure in Terraform and containerise legacy jobs with Docker. Small automation scripts are written in Python. The contract is remote and initially scoped for one year. Please highlight similar consolidation projects in your application.

title: iOS Developer
description: Velloria Retail is opening a mobile team in Madrid to build its shopping app for iOS. You will develop new screens in SwiftUI, integrate with our REST APIs and improve app start-up time. You will work with a product designer and an Android developer on shared features. We release every two weeks through a staged rollout. Published apps or open-source Swift work will help your application stand out.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Gravelune Insurance offers a six-month internship in its analytics team in Vienna. You will help prepare monthly claims reports, write SQL queries and automate small tasks in Python. A mentor will review your work and help you present results to stakeholders. Students in statistics, economics or computer science are encouraged to apply. Internship compensation follows the collective agreement and is shared during interviews.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (TypeScript)
description: Fennick Agritech is building a field-planning web app that farm managers use from tablets in the field. You will work across an Angular frontend and Node.js services written in TypeScript, with PostgreSQL for storage. Offline support and clear map-based interfaces are key challenges. The team is remote across Poland and Ukraine and meets in person twice a year. Experience with Docker and relational data modelling is expected.

title: Product Designer
description: Nimbalo Payments is hiring a product designer for the merchant onboarding experience. You will run user research with shop owners, prototype flows in Figma and work with engineers until features ship. Simplifying complex compliance steps is the main challenge of this area. You will contribute to the shared design system and design critiques. A portfolio showing end-to-end product work is required.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description: Ovantia Logistics is looking for a part-time support engineer to handle second-line tickets about parcel lockers. You will investigate issues with SQL queries, read service logs on Linux servers and write small Python scripts to fix data. Clear written communication with the operations team is essential. Shifts are planned a week in advance and can fit around university studies. This role is a common path into our engineering teams.

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description: Kelvara Energy is splitting its forecasting monolith into event-driven services. As a staff engineer you will shape that architecture, write key parts of it in C# on .NET and guide teams through the migration. Services exchange events through Kafka and run in Docker on Azure, with SQL databases per service. You will write design documents, run architecture reviews and mentor senior engineers. The role is remote within Spain.

title: Freelance Data Visualisation Developer
description: Halvering Media publishes interactive audience reports for its advertising partners. We are looking for a freelancer to build custom charts with D3.js and TypeScript for the next quarterly report. Data is prepared by our analysts in SQL and Python, and you will help shape the final datasets. The work is project-based and fully remote. Share links to interactive visualisations you have built when applying.

title: Junior Angular Developer
description: Ovantia Logistics is building a customer portal where people track deliveries and manage locker pickups. As a junior Angular developer you will implement pages and forms in Angular with TypeScript. You will receive structured onboarding, code reviews from senior engineers and time for learning. Good HTML and CSS knowledge and comfort with Git are required. The team works hybrid from Kyiv.

title: QA Lead
description: Orvexa Robotics wants to raise release confidence for its fleet software. As QA lead you will define the test strategy, grow a team of three QA engineers and build automation with Playwright and Python. You will integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines and use Docker to run realistic test environments. Working with simulation data in SQL is part of the job. Prior experience leading QA for a complex product is required.

title: Cloud Solutions Architect (AWS)
description: Fennick Agritech is expanding into Germany and needs a contract architect to design its AWS footprint for the region. You will define account structure, networking and data residency controls, and codify them in Terraform. You will also guide teams moving Docker workloads onto Kubernetes. Some automation will be written in Python. The contract is hybrid, with regular visits to our Munich office.
